## 📋 Description

Please include a summary of the change and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes # (issue)

## 🛠️ Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / Benchmarks

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run lint` and resolved all warnings.
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run typecheck` and passed without errors.
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run test` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README if applicable.
